required_locations.datasets/timenet-registry: PTB-XL 1.0.3 TimeNet registry; source hash is in each trial.json.
required_locations.outputs/ptbxl-diffusets-classification-1: Complete accepted-signal snapshot, candidate plan, snapshot manifest and provenance used by the 1,530-signal preparation script.

required_locations.runs/<experiment>/<regime>/<arm>/seed<n>: Checkpoints and prediction tables named and hashed in result.json and experiment_freeze.json; required to rerun reporting that recomputes metrics.

restoration: Restore these files in a separate copy of the runtime tree. Existing run claims are historical evidence and must not be erased to rerun held-out scoring. Use new output identities for new experiments.
